status_definitions.VALIDATED: Empirical evidence demonstrates economically meaningful incremental value over a simpler baseline.
status_definitions.RESEARCH_ONLY: Experimental and prohibited from affecting production decisions, sizing, reports, or email.
status_definitions.REJECTED: Tested and not worth its incremental complexity.
status_definitions.CORE_RISK_CONTROL: Primarily protects operational safety; this is not an alpha-validation claim.
status_definitions.UNASSESSED: Evidence is missing or insufficient; existing production presence is not validation.

filters.name: Stage 2 structure
filters.production_effect: Candidate discovery gate before the canonical final decision.
filters.evidence_summary: Implemented; no repository evidence establishes incremental out-of-sample value.
filters.notes: Do not infer validation from production presence.

filters.name: Recent relative strength
filters.production_effect: Primary-edge gate and ranking input; missing or sufficiently weak values block actionability.
filters.evidence_summary: A survivorship-biased 2017-2023 engineering discovery found the fixed >=70 rule worse than MODEL_0; this is not validation evidence.
filters.discovery_result: 263 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.216R versus 0.348R baseline; profit factor 1.402 versus 1.644; maximum drawdown 29.281R versus 22.284R.
filters.notes: Remain UNASSESSED. Requires independent point-in-time validation; do not change production from the biased discovery result.

filters.name: Long-term relative strength
filters.production_effect: Candidate scoring, ordering, and leadership context.
filters.evidence_summary: A survivorship-biased 2017-2023 engineering discovery found the fixed >=75 rule worse than MODEL_0; this is not validation evidence.
filters.discovery_result: 278 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.280R versus 0.348R baseline; profit factor 1.484 versus 1.644; maximum drawdown 25.516R versus 22.284R.
filters.notes: Remain UNASSESSED. Test jointly with Recent RS using independent point-in-time data.

filters.name: Market regime
filters.production_effect: Controls new-risk permission and heat and contributes market context.
filters.evidence_summary: Operational behavior is tested; incremental expectancy/drawdown evidence for the model is not recorded.
filters.notes: Risk purpose does not automatically validate current regime thresholds.

filters.name: Industry qualification
filters.production_effect: Secondary confirmation and ranking; incomplete coverage cannot silently grant confirmation.
filters.evidence_summary: Synthetic ranking invariants exist; no out-of-sample trade ablation is recorded.
filters.notes: Historical point-in-time classification coverage is a known limitation.

filters.name: Sister-stock confirmation
filters.production_effect: Secondary confirmation that may reduce FULL to HALF but cannot repair failed primary edge.
filters.evidence_summary: A survivorship-biased 2017-2023 engineering discovery found little incremental value for the fixed >=0.30 rule; this is not validation evidence.
filters.discovery_result: 261 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.317R versus 0.348R baseline; profit factor 1.576 versus 1.644; maximum drawdown unchanged at 22.284R.
filters.notes: Requires point-in-time industry membership and breadth.

filters.name: Setup tightness
filters.production_effect: Contributes setup integrity, category consistency, ranking, and actionability.
filters.evidence_summary: Semantic behavior is tested; no empirical expectancy delta is recorded.
filters.notes: Test with VCP and pullback features for correlated complexity.

filters.name: VCP quality
filters.production_effect: Contributes setup integrity and ranking.
filters.evidence_summary: No controlled ablation result is recorded.
filters.notes: Measure interaction with tightness before promotion or removal.

filters.name: Pullback quality
filters.production_effect: Contributes setup integrity, category ordering, and report ranking.
filters.evidence_summary: No controlled ablation result is recorded.
filters.notes: Evaluate both alpha and trade-frequency effects.

filters.name: Volume confirmation
filters.production_effect: Secondary confirmation that may reduce FULL to HALF.
filters.evidence_summary: No controlled ablation result is recorded.
filters.notes: Remain UNASSESSED. Test threshold stability and interaction with setup type on independent data.

filters.name: Structural reward/risk
filters.production_effect: A valid observed target and configured minimum structural R/R are hard actionability gates.
filters.evidence_summary: Risk semantics are invariant-tested. A mechanical observed-resistance proxy was so restrictive that it selected only 7, 1, and 5 signals across reused stages; this is not a production-parity ablation.
filters.discovery_result: The causal signal-close proxy accepted five trades from seven selected development signals and returned 4.86%; the sample was far below the frozen 75-trade floor.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. It selected one signal in 2024 and five in 2025. A blue-sky exception restored opportunity but did not produce stable portfolio edge.
filters.notes: Remain UNASSESSED for production. Synthetic model targets cannot masquerade as observed resistance, and the mechanical proxy cannot establish whether the distinct production gate adds value.

filters.name: Distance from pivot
filters.production_effect: Contributes entry timing and ranking.
filters.evidence_summary: No controlled ablation result is recorded.
filters.notes: Requires an observable point-in-time pivot definition.

filters.name: Entry timing
filters.production_effect: Blocks overextended entries and can reduce otherwise valid setups from FULL to HALF.
filters.evidence_summary: A survivorship-biased engineering proxy test of the current EMA/high extension limits reduced drawdown but not expectancy; detailed entry timing remains untested.
filters.discovery_result: 255 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.324R versus 0.348R baseline; maximum drawdown 18.276R versus 22.284R.
filters.notes: Remain UNASSESSED. This was only an extension-limit proxy with next-session execution, not the full entry-timing state machine.

filters.name: MarketSmith-style 12-month RS proxy
filters.production_effect: NONE; adaptive robustness variants only.
filters.evidence_summary: Three preregistered diagnostics found no stable hard-threshold value. The opportunity-first audit found proxy >=80 expectancy deltas of -0.105R, -0.084R, and +0.071R across the three reused stages.
filters.discovery_result: Proxy >=80 accepted 142 trades: 18.77% return, 16.87% maximum drawdown, 0.132R expectancy, and 1.197 profit factor versus baseline 42.78%, 9.75%, 0.345R, and 1.691. Proxy >=90 lost 10.81%.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. V2 fixed buckets all returned less than baseline in 2024 and 2025. Requiring positive one- and three-month score changes returned 7.32% in 2024 and 28.58% with 13.23% drawdown in 2025 after losing 6.71% in development.
filters.notes: This is a declared four-quarter proxy with 21- and 63-session changes, not MarketSmith's proprietary RS Rating. Reject the tested hard cutoff; retain the continuous score only as a prospective ranking hypothesis.

filters.name: Stock/SPY RS line near 252-session high
filters.production_effect: NONE; adaptive robustness only.
filters.evidence_summary: Near-high and exact RS-line-leads-price variants did not improve the fixed-2R baseline; the exact lead was sparse and unstable.
filters.discovery_result: 105 trades; 23.81% return, 9.79% maximum drawdown, 0.227R expectancy, and 1.547 profit factor versus baseline 42.78%, 9.75%, 0.345R, and 1.691.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. The exact RS-line lead accepted 4 trades for 3.43% in 2024 and 10 trades for -2.31% in 2025. The older near-high variant returned 1.26% and 19.98% with 16.00% 2025 drawdown.
filters.notes: Remain RESEARCH_ONLY and HOLD. No untouched holdout exists.

filters.name: Current-classification industry RS proxy
filters.production_effect: NONE; adaptive robustness only.
filters.evidence_summary: Static hard gates and policy variants failed prior portfolio gates. Opportunity-first strong-industry filtering received only risk/quality support, not alpha support, and had no matching prior portfolio shortlist.
filters.discovery_result: 136 trades; 14.75% return, 16.85% maximum drawdown, 0.108R expectancy, and 1.184 profit factor.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. Secondary half-risk returned 14.69% / 2.74% drawdown in 2024 but 15.64% / 7.63% in 2025 after failing development. Rank-only returned 2.83% and 15.61%; breadth acceleration lost 1.22% in 2025.
filters.notes: Classifications are current, not effective-dated; only 62%-66% of signals had usable labels in the concentration audit. Keep industry strength as a prospective ranking hypothesis, not a validated hard gate.

filters.name: 50-session up/down-volume ratio
filters.production_effect: NONE; adaptive robustness only.
filters.evidence_summary: The fixed >=1.25 confirmation was unstable across reused periods and failed the development drawdown gate.
filters.discovery_result: 136 trades; 47.02% return, 12.84% maximum drawdown, 0.346R expectancy, and 1.591 profit factor.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. Lost 2.35% in 2024 and returned 16.90% with 14.32% drawdown in 2025; the largest winner supplied 86.7% of 2025 positive P&L.
filters.notes: Remain RESEARCH_ONLY and HOLD; this proxy is not the full production volume-confirmation logic.

filters.name: Combined technical leader profile
filters.production_effect: NONE; adaptive robustness only.
filters.evidence_summary: V1's combined leader profile surrendered most baseline return; V2's completed RS-plus-base conjunction selected no eligible test signals.
filters.discovery_result: 260 selected signals and 78 accepted trades; 6.33% return, 7.70% maximum drawdown, 0.081R expectancy, and 1.201 profit factor.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. V1 selected eight signals/six trades in 2024 and 12 trades in 2025. V2's complete technical leader selected zero signals in every test stage; only one of 48,510 full-archive MODEL_0 signals met the full conjunction before period/blackout selection.
filters.notes: The exact frozen composite is REJECTED as unusably restrictive. No threshold retuning is authorized from these outcomes. A simpler future model requires a new preregistration and genuinely unseen data.

filters.name: Completed mechanical base and pivot quality
filters.production_effect: NONE; frozen V2 research proxies only.
filters.evidence_summary: Most base variants remained mixed. Opportunity-first pivot/supply filtering improved profit factor and MAE in all three reused stages but had no development bootstrap alpha support or matching prior portfolio shortlist.
filters.discovery_result: Pivot-supply-clear was the only all-stage absolute gate pass: 121 trades, 39.12% return, 9.35% drawdown, and 0.323R expectancy versus baseline 42.78%, 9.75%, and 0.345R. Complete base quality selected only 87 signals and 47 trades.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. Pivot-supply-clear returned 6.71% / 3.90% drawdown in 2024 and 6.33% / 3.41% in 2025, below baseline return and return/drawdown in both. Contraction/dry-up made an isolated 66.94% in 2025 after 51.71% development drawdown.
filters.notes: The exact V2 hard-gate stack remains REJECTED as alpha. Pivot/supply may be tested prospectively as a continuous ranking feature; do not promote or retune it on reused history.

filters.name: Three-session delayed breakout follow-through
filters.production_effect: NONE; causal research timing variant only.
filters.evidence_summary: The delayed confirmation improved development drawdown but was sparse and lost money in reused 2024.
filters.discovery_result: 100 confirmations before the confirmation-date earnings recheck, 98 eligible, and 55 accepted trades; 16.03% return, 3.87% drawdown, 0.292R expectancy, and 2.167 profit factor. It missed the 75-trade floor.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. Nine accepted trades lost 2.44% in 2024; nine returned 6.25% with 1.63% drawdown in 2025.
filters.notes: The exact frozen confirmation rule is REJECTED. It used information only through the confirmation close, entered next session, and reapplied the earnings blackout.

filters.name: Mechanical superperformance entry paths V1
filters.production_effect: NONE; 18-variant adaptive robustness experiment only.
filters.evidence_summary: No mature breakout, blue-sky, quality, tight-base, pullback, multi-path, ranking, or trailing variant entered the frozen cross-stage shortlist.
filters.discovery_result: The strongest broad path was multi-path plus production-style RS at 47.10% return, but drawdown was 12.45% and it failed reused 2025. Quality breakout returned 0.70%; tight base lost 4.12%; constructive pullback reached 11.72% drawdown.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. No one of 18 variants passed every stage gate and the cross-stage shortlist count was zero.
filters.notes: The exact V1 specification is REJECTED. It is a causal mechanical translation, not historical Daily Watchlist production parity.

filters.name: Short-history young-leader breakout path
filters.production_effect: NONE; frozen research path only.
filters.evidence_summary: The standalone path had positive expectancy, profit factor, and return with low drawdown in all reused periods, but was underpowered and outlier-dependent; prioritizing it inside MODEL_0 failed the complete additive gate.
filters.discovery_result: 156 selected signals and 48 accepted trades; 15.21% return, 4.66% drawdown, 0.317R expectancy, and 2.335 profit factor. It failed the 75-trade floor.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. Eight trades returned 6.07% with 1.28% drawdown in 2024; seven returned 13.16% with 5.46% drawdown in 2025. SNDK supplied 77.25% of 2025 positive P&L.
filters.notes: This is 90-219 valid sessions in the available archive, not verified IPO age. The frozen additive follow-up was rejected. Do not retune on reused history or promote; only newly arriving point-in-time observation could add evidence.

filters.name: Young-leader priority inside MODEL_0
filters.production_effect: NONE; five-variant adaptive follow-up only.
filters.evidence_summary: Young-first priority improved development and reused-2024 return/drawdown but failed reused-2025 risk and outlier gates; both declared ordering neighbors provided no directional support.
filters.discovery_result: 120 accepted trades; 58.70% return, 8.92% drawdown, 0.489R expectancy, and 1.984 profit factor versus baseline 42.78%, 9.75%, 0.345R, and 1.691.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. Young-first returned 12.30% / 3.92% drawdown in 2024, then 27.00% / 13.07% in 2025. The largest winner supplied 74.39% of 2025 positive P&L. Default and MODEL_0-first ordering did not improve the baseline.
filters.notes: REJECT the exact priority sleeve. Only three newly accepted development trades were young signals; downstream capacity reshuffling admitted large mature winners, demonstrating strong portfolio-path dependence.

filters.name: Frozen technical superperformance ranking V1
filters.production_effect: NONE; research candidate order only.
filters.evidence_summary: The fixed RS, volume, close-location, tightness, and blue-sky weighted rank worsened the multi-path portfolio in every reused stage and did not improve quality breakout robustly.
filters.discovery_result: Ranked multi-path return fell from 30.56% to 12.98% while drawdown rose from 12.24% to 24.10%.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. Ranked multi-path returned -0.09% in 2024 and -9.14% in 2025 versus 8.89% and -11.08% for its parent; quality ranking also lacked stable benefit.
filters.notes: Reject this exact weight formula and candidate-order rule. Do not retune it on the same reused periods.

filters.name: Bounded individual-filter and six-component combination audit
filters.production_effect: NONE; 80-variant adaptive diagnostic only.
filters.evidence_summary: No one of 64 complete factorial subsets plus 16 supplemental individual filters met the frozen cross-stage, outlier, and leave-one-out shortlist rule.
filters.discovery_result: MODEL_0 had 25,413 executable candidates but accepted only 124 under fixed 2R heat. Seven variants passed all absolute stage gates, but none showed the required relative and component-level incremental value.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. The cumulative six-filter conjunction retained 7, 0, and 0 signals across development, 2024, and 2025. The shortlist count was zero.
filters.notes: Reject the exact hard-filter matrix. Current low trade count is mainly a 2R-capacity constraint, so future research should test preregistered candidate ordering on genuinely new point-in-time data rather than mine more hard-filter thresholds on the reused archive.

filters.name: Opportunity-first filter and industry-concentration audit
filters.production_effect: NONE; opportunity, combination, and concentration diagnostic only.
filters.evidence_summary: No one of 80 variants achieved alpha support. Two individual filters received risk/quality support, five bounded combinations passed leave-one-out, and none also had prior fixed-2R portfolio support.
filters.discovery_result: The 25,413 executable development signals became 14,083 non-overlapping ticker episodes before portfolio constraints. Strong industry and pivot/supply received risk/quality support, but every development block-bootstrap alpha lower bound failed to clear zero.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. Baseline opportunity counts were 2,101 and 2,295 in 2024/2025. Sequential-plus-prior-portfolio support count was zero.
filters.notes: Reject the exact legacy hard-filter matrix. Preserve industry, pivot/setup, RS, and volume only as preregistered ranking hypotheses on genuinely new data.

filters.name: Point-in-time fundamental acceleration
filters.production_effect: NONE; unavailable research component.
filters.evidence_summary: BLOCKED_DATA_NOT_READY: no point-in-time EPS, sales, margins, estimates, ownership, or sponsorship archive is available.
filters.notes: Do not substitute current fundamentals or retrospective fields.

filters.name: Exclude low-beta stocks
filters.production_effect: NONE; requested hypothesis only.
filters.evidence_summary: A fixed rolling-beta >=0.8 rule underperformed both before and after applying the mandatory earnings blackout, and also weakened the frozen technical-leader profile.
filters.discovery_result: With the earnings blackout: 281 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.118R versus 0.350R baseline; profit factor 1.192 versus 1.653; maximum drawdown 28.57R versus 21.64R.
filters.notes: Do not promote as an alpha rule. Within LEADER_RS_ROBUSTNESS_V1, the beta overlay returned 0.73%, 2.29%, and -0.69% across reused stages and failed every stage gate. Beta used 126 sessions through the signal date; the user's preference may remain a portfolio mandate, but independent validation is unavailable.

filters.name: Exclude Utilities sector
filters.production_effect: NONE; requested hypothesis only.
filters.evidence_summary: The earlier apparent benefit from excluding Utilities reversed after applying the mandatory earnings blackout. A later technical-leader interaction was sparse and unstable; classifications remain current rather than effective-dated.
filters.discovery_result: With the earnings blackout: 267 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.263R versus 0.350R baseline; profit factor 1.456 versus 1.653; maximum drawdown 34.02R versus 21.64R.
filters.notes: Unstable adaptive evidence; do not promote as alpha. In LEADER_RS_ROBUSTNESS_V1, excluding Utilities improved technical-profile development return from 6.33% to 13.45% but left only six 2024 trades and reduced 2025 return. The user's preference may remain a mandate, but research requires effective-dated sector classification and independent validation.

filters.name: ATR initial stops and fixed-R profit targets
filters.production_effect: NONE; requested 20-combination research grid only.
filters.evidence_summary: All fixed 2R/2.5R/3R targets and ATR-based initial stops underperformed the no-target/20-day-low baseline in survivorship-biased discovery.
filters.discovery_result: The baseline retained 259 capacity-limited trades at 0.348R expectancy, 1.644 profit factor, and 22.284R maximum drawdown. The best non-baseline expectancy was 0.242R; fixed-target variants ranged from -0.082R to 0.062R. No combination met the preregistered shortlist gate.
filters.notes: Keep research-only. All 20 cells reused one current-universe discovery sample. A later boundary audit found early-2024 price use by late-2023 outcomes, so early 2024 is contaminated for this version; independent point-in-time validation is unavailable.

filters.name: Combined exits, stops, and portfolio exposure
filters.production_effect: NONE; full 180-cell discovery cross only.
filters.evidence_summary: One of 180 preregistered cells passed the absolute discovery gate, but it was a complex isolated target optimum with weak later-period performance.
filters.discovery_result: The 20-day-low stop, 2R target, earned-2R plus 2R/4R/6R drawdown cell accepted 170 trades at 0.194R expectancy, 1.573 profit factor, 33.02% return, and 4.65% max daily MTM drawdown. Adjacent 2.5R/3R targets accepted only 31/43 trades and returned 0% in the later discovery period.
filters.notes: Remain RESEARCH_ONLY and HOLD. Multiple-testing, survivorship bias, low neighboring stability, and missing independent validation prohibit forward-strategy freeze or production promotion.

filters.name: Simple stop, exit, and exposure cross-validation
filters.production_effect: NONE; frozen 168-cell discovery, 2024 validation, and conditional 2025 holdout only.
filters.evidence_summary: The simple fixed-2R/20-day-low/40-session candidate passed discovery and the frozen 2024 validation, but failed the one-time 2025 holdout drawdown gate.
filters.discovery_result: 123 accepted trades; 72.96% return, 0.593R expectancy, 2.198 profit factor, and 6.97% maximum daily MTM drawdown.
filters.validation_result: 2024: 12 accepted trades; 6.74% return, 0.561R expectancy, 2.420 profit factor, and 4.03% maximum drawdown; frozen gate pass.
filters.holdout_result: 2025: 13 accepted trades; 26.94% return, 2.072R expectancy, 8.521 profit factor, and 13.29% maximum drawdown; frozen gate fail because drawdown exceeded 10%.
filters.notes: Remain RESEARCH_ONLY and HOLD. The archive is survivorship-biased, post-2023 accepted samples are small and path-dependent, and no combination proved the <=10% drawdown objective.

filters.name: Win-to-three, loss-to-two exposure discipline
filters.production_effect: NONE; adaptive robustness only.
filters.evidence_summary: The clarified 2R/3R state machine was highly unstable across reused periods and did not control development drawdown.
filters.discovery_result: Without earnings blackout in reused 2017-2023: 160 trades, 14.20% return, 0.089R expectancy, 1.151 profit factor, and 22.06% maximum drawdown versus fixed-2R 72.96% return and 6.97% drawdown.
filters.validation_result: Reused March 2024-October 2025, not independent: 37 trades, 19.56% return, 0.529R expectancy, 2.395 profit factor, and 6.93% maximum drawdown.
filters.notes: Remain RESEARCH_ONLY. It correctly never exceeded three positions but failed older-period risk stability; there is no untouched holdout.

filters.name: Repeated win-expand, loss-contract exposure staircase
filters.production_effect: NONE; adaptive robustness only.
filters.evidence_summary: All six 2R-start staircase variants failed the complete two-period gate because reused 2017-2023 maximum drawdown exceeded 10%.
filters.discovery_result: Reused 2017-2023: dynamic variants accepted 179-214 trades, returned 33.54%-83.11%, had 0.176R-0.464R expectancy and 1.293-1.802 profit factor, but reached 15.58%-16.59% maximum drawdown. Fixed 2R returned 42.78% with 9.75% drawdown.
filters.validation_result: Reused March 2024-October 2025, not independent: 4R STEP/RESET and 6R/8R RESET stayed below 10% drawdown, while 6R/8R STEP reached 12.91%. No dynamic rule passed both periods.
filters.notes: Remain RESEARCH_ONLY and HOLD. The fixed-2R earnings-blackout baseline was the only numeric two-period gate pass. Prices are survivorship-biased, earnings dates are retrospective, and there is no untouched holdout.

filters.name: Ten-calendar-day pre-earnings signal blackout
filters.production_effect: NONE; retrospective earnings-date proxy only.
filters.evidence_summary: The blackout is now enforced across 385 adaptive retest settings. It materially changed rankings but produced no robust two-period <=10% drawdown solution.
filters.discovery_result: The boundary-purged signal universe fell from 29,452 to 25,456. No 180-cell cross passed. Two simple fixed-2R/no-target cells passed development; filter effects, especially Utilities exclusion, were unstable.
filters.validation_result: Reused 2024 numeric gates passed for the 30- and 40-session fixed-2R candidates. Both failed reused 2025 at 12.86% and 13.07% maximum drawdown; these samples are REUSED_CONTAMINATED, not independent.
filters.notes: Keep as the user's mandatory research-universe constraint, not a validated alpha filter. Historical Yahoo event dates were retrieved retrospectively and may differ from schedules known on signal dates; production remains unchanged.

filters.name: SPY market entry and heat gate
filters.production_effect: NONE; SPY-only historical robustness cross.
filters.evidence_summary: The SPY-above-SMA50 gate was the only market-only policy to pass every reused stage gate, but it reduced later-period return and is not the production market-regime model.
filters.discovery_result: SPY above SMA50 with no trailing stop: 105 accepted trades, 58.21% return, 8.01% max drawdown, 0.554R expectancy, and 2.026 profit factor versus the unrestricted 42.78% / 9.75% / 0.345R / 1.691 baseline.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. 2024 returned 9.59% with 4.54% drawdown versus 9.93% / 3.93% unrestricted; 2025 returned 6.58% with 5.95% drawdown versus 28.01% / 13.07% unrestricted.
filters.notes: Keep research-only and HOLD. It reduced 2025 risk largely by excluding the exceptional RGLD path. Full production-regime reconstruction requires additional point-in-time inputs.

filters.name: 2R/3R-activated SMA20 profit-protection stop
filters.production_effect: NONE; causal historical robustness cross.
filters.evidence_summary: Only the SPY-above-SMA50 plus 2R-activated SMA20-minus-1ATR20 rule improved its same-market no-trailing return in all three reused periods; nearby offsets were materially unstable.
filters.discovery_result: With the SMA50 gate, the 2R/SMA20-minus-1ATR20 rule accepted 104 trades and returned 65.63% with 7.54% drawdown, 0.631R expectancy, and 2.255 profit factor versus 58.21% / 8.01% / 0.554R / 2.026 without trailing protection.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. The same rule returned 11.41% / 4.54% drawdown in 2024 and 8.81% / 3.98% in 2025; the matching no-trailing gate returned 9.59% / 4.54% and 6.58% / 5.95%.
filters.notes: Keep research-only and HOLD. Reused 2024 was dominated by one 10.22R winner, and the exact SMA20 neighbor returned only 0.43% with 11.99% development drawdown. No production or forward specification changed.

filters.name: Earn the right to expand exposure
filters.production_effect: NONE; requested portfolio-allocation hypothesis only.
filters.evidence_summary: Two permanent 2R-start ladders were tested in survivorship-biased discovery and did not keep daily mark-to-market drawdown below 10%.
filters.discovery_result: Both ladders unlocked 4R by 2017-03-03, selected the same 248 trades, returned 81.40%, and reached 16.97% maximum drawdown.
filters.notes: Do not promote. The permanent early-profit unlock did not control later-cycle exposure; a future redesign requires a new preregistered experiment.

filters.name: Deterministic portfolio candidate ranking interface
filters.production_effect: Research arms have no production effect; the existing Final Score/ticker production baseline ordering separately changes scarce-capacity allocation and its explicit approval record is unverified.
filters.evidence_summary: Engineering-only Phase A interface, causal factor builder, input-contract runner, stage-boundary censoring, per-ranker production concentration, strict shortlist gate, complete blocked-reason audit, and permutation regressions; no outcome sample has been evaluated and formal data remains blocked.
filters.notes: Preregistered arms are production Final Score, deterministic SHA-256 random order, four continuous factors, an exact 25% composite, and four equal-weight leave-one-out variants. Candidate concentration is reapplied after each ranker orders candidates. Both baseline and challenger must meet the frozen sample floor. Formal execution rejects the current non-effective-dated classifications. No champion is selected automatically; formal Phase A, Phase B, and Phase C are not complete, and the point-in-time data gate remains NOT_READY. The already-implemented production baseline ordering is governed separately by docs/PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE_ORDERING.md and is not authorized by this research record.

filters.name: Pattern Discovery report separation
filters.production_effect: NONE; post-canonical report classification only.
filters.evidence_summary: Engineering separation of Actionable Now, Pattern Watchlist, and Avoid / Failed. This is not trading-edge evidence.
filters.notes: Classification runs only after canonical production decisions. Missing entry, target, or R/R remains explicit; research fields cannot alter decision, actionability, risk, shares, or trade-plan values. Phase 2 lanes consume this post-canonical Pattern Watchlist boundary without changing Phase 1 precedence.

filters.name: Pattern lane: Tight Base / VCP
filters.production_effect: NONE; post-canonical Pattern Watchlist membership and chart-review ranking only.
filters.evidence_summary: Deterministic engineering implementation with production-isolation and missing-data tests; no trading-outcome or incremental-edge evaluation has been run.
filters.notes: Ranks existing Pattern Watchlist rows using narrow contraction, VCP, volume, pivot/high proximity, RS, and prior-advance evidence. Missing factors are explicit and missing-last. This is not a Phase 3 quality framework or a validated edge claim.

filters.name: Pattern lane: Pullback to Support
filters.production_effect: NONE; post-canonical Pattern Watchlist membership and chart-review ranking only.
filters.evidence_summary: Deterministic engineering implementation with production-isolation and missing-data tests; no trading-outcome or incremental-edge evaluation has been run.
filters.notes: Separates support proximity from reclaim evidence, prior advance, higher-low structure, ATR depth, volume, and close strength. A moving-average touch alone cannot receive the top research quality label.

filters.name: Pattern lane: Breakout Retest / High Flag
filters.production_effect: NONE; post-canonical Pattern Watchlist membership and chart-review ranking only.
filters.evidence_summary: Deterministic rolling-lookback engineering implementation with production-isolation and missing-state tests; no trading-outcome or incremental-edge evaluation has been run.
filters.notes: Distinguishes near-pivot, same-day unconfirmed breakout, post-breakout hold/consolidation, and invalidation using a bounded point-in-time lookback. No persistent Phase 4 lifecycle exists; same-day breakout is never labelled a confirmed retest/high flag.

filters.name: Chart quality: Prior Advance Quality
filters.production_effect: NONE; deterministic post-discovery explanation only.
filters.evidence_summary: Engineering implementation and synthetic direction/isolation tests only; no trading-outcome or incremental-edge evaluation has been run.
filters.notes: Combines the existing 60-session pre-setup advance return with path efficiency, constructive-session share, maximum internal drawdown, reversal count, and one-day progress concentration. Larger return alone is not higher quality.

filters.name: Chart quality: Trend Smoothness
filters.production_effect: NONE; deterministic post-discovery explanation only.
filters.evidence_summary: Engineering implementation and synthetic direction/isolation tests only; no trading-outcome or incremental-edge evaluation has been run.
filters.notes: Uses 40-session direction, path efficiency, positive-session share, simple log-price regression fit/slope, and large reversal frequency. Flat low-volatility behaviour cannot receive the smooth-uptrend state.

filters.name: Chart quality: Distribution / Wide-Bar Penalty
filters.production_effect: NONE; explanatory penalty only, never a production hard gate.
filters.evidence_summary: Engineering implementation and synthetic direction/isolation tests only; no trading-outcome or incremental-edge evaluation has been run.
filters.notes: Counts recent downside bars with at least two of wide true range, high volume, and weak close evidence. Higher numeric values are worse; one isolated event cannot exceed the LIGHT state by itself, and missing volume is unavailable rather than favourable.

filters.name: Chart quality: Overhead Supply
filters.production_effect: NONE; deterministic post-discovery explanation only.
filters.evidence_summary: Engineering implementation and synthetic point-in-time/isolation tests only; no trading-outcome or incremental-edge evaluation has been run.
filters.notes: Uses only prior 60-session high proximity and price-range/close congestion above current price. No future-confirmed swing high or unsupported volume-at-price profile is used.

filters.name: Chart quality: Contraction Quality
filters.production_effect: NONE; Phase 2 Tight Base membership, score, and rank are unchanged.
filters.evidence_summary: Engineering implementation and synthetic compatibility/isolation tests only; no trading-outcome or incremental-edge evaluation has been run.
filters.notes: Reuses Phase 2-compatible 10D/20D range, ADR20/ADR60, and recent-five/prior-20 volume definitions and adds deterministic three-block sequential contraction. Price-only, volume-only, multi-dimensional, expanding, and missing-volume states stay distinct.

filters.name: Chart quality: Support Respect
filters.production_effect: NONE; Phase 2 Pullback membership and quality remain authoritative for that lane.
filters.evidence_summary: Engineering implementation and synthetic proximity/hold/break/isolation tests only; no trading-outcome or incremental-edge evaluation has been run.
filters.notes: Selects one nearby EMA20/EMA10/MA50/pivot reference deterministically by absolute ATR distance and fixed tie priority, then reports tests, holds, reclaims, and destructive breaches. Proximity alone is ambiguous. Favourable Phase 3 evidence cannot repair a Phase 2 non-member or missing-support quality label.

filters.name: Chart quality: Relative Strength Persistence
filters.production_effect: NONE; existing Recent RS production and Phase 2 behaviour are unchanged.
filters.evidence_summary: Engineering implementation and synthetic benchmark-relative direction/isolation tests only; no trading-outcome or incremental-edge evaluation has been run.
filters.notes: Keeps current cross-sectional Recent RS separate from the aligned 20-session stock/SPY relative path, positive-session persistence, rolling-baseline persistence, trend fit, recent acceleration/deterioration, and one-day progress concentration. Missing benchmark/history/current level is unavailable.

filters.name: Critical data validity and freshness
filters.production_effect: Missing, stale, anomalous, or incomplete critical data blocks actionability or publication.
filters.evidence_summary: Classified for operational safety, not claimed alpha. A cap of two positions per industry was explicitly isolated from filter selection.
filters.discovery_result: At fixed 2R heat and 1R per trade, cap two was exactly redundant in every reused stage. At 0.5R per trade it rejected three development candidates, did not reduce drawdown, and had no effect in 2024/2025.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only; current-industry coverage was 62%-66% and was not effective-dated.
filters.notes: Covered by data-quality, regression, and semantic-invariant tests.

filters.name: Valid structural stop
filters.production_effect: Invalid or unavailable stops block actionability and sizing.
filters.evidence_summary: Classified for operational safety, not claimed alpha.
filters.notes: Covered by decision and report invariant tests.

filters.name: Portfolio heat and concentration
filters.production_effect: Caps total, industry, and theme risk and may block otherwise actionable candidates.
filters.evidence_summary: Classified for operational safety, not claimed alpha.
filters.notes: Remain CORE_RISK_CONTROL. Cap two matters only when total capacity can exceed two positions; with two total positions, cap one is required to prevent both holdings sharing an industry.

filters.name: Maximum simultaneous positions
filters.production_effect: Blocks new positions once the configured hard cap is reached.
filters.evidence_summary: A survivorship-biased allocation study found materially different return/drawdown trade-offs across fixed 1R to 4R heat; this calibrates risk but is not validation evidence.
filters.discovery_result: Fixed 4R selected 254 trades, returned 88.24%, and reached 20.31% daily MTM max drawdown. Fixed 2R selected 123 trades, returned 72.96%, and reached 6.97% max drawdown; it missed the 150-trade gate.
filters.notes: Remain CORE_RISK_CONTROL. Current configured default is four; the promising fixed-2R discovery requires independent validation and has not changed production.

filters.name: Drawdown risk modes
filters.production_effect: Reduces or stops new risk as account drawdown increases.
filters.evidence_summary: Survivorship-biased discovery showed that fixed-R drawdown stops reduced measured drawdown mainly by blocking new risk for most later sessions; current calibration is not empirically validated.
filters.discovery_result: The 2R/4R/6R overlay accepted 27 trades, returned 21.11%, reached 5.41% max drawdown, and blocked new risk for 1,482 sessions. The 3R/6R/9R overlay accepted 52 trades and blocked for 1,331 sessions.
filters.notes: Remain CORE_RISK_CONTROL. Separate correctness of enforcement from empirical calibration; no tested drawdown overlay passed the complete shortlist gate.
